summary.en: Tight jeans, tighter songs—guitars sneak back through downtown doors.
summary.zh: 牛仔裤更紧，歌也更紧——吉他从市中心的门缝溜回来。

sound.en: Garage snap, post-punk freeze, indie as a look again
sound.zh: Garage 脆响、后朋克的冻、indie 再次成为造型

body.en:
After nu-metal billboards and laptop pop, a New York band in leather makes three-minute songs feel dangerous again. The Strokes don't invent revival; they make it photogenic. Arctic Monkeys later prove the internet can mint a UK guitar band overnight.

The chronicle axis holds: rock isn't dead, it just needed a haircut and a smaller room—before the rooms get big again.
body.zh:
在新金属广告牌和笔记本流行乐之后，纽约一支穿皮衣的乐队让三分钟的歌再次危险。The Strokes 没有发明复兴；他们让复兴上镜。后来 Arctic Monkeys 证明互联网能一夜造出一支英伦吉他乐队。

编年主轴还在：摇滚没死，它只是需要理个发、换个小房间——然后房间又会变大。
